Each stage connected by arrows showing the logical progression from philosophical foundations through practical application." suggestedAsset="Diagram or reference image" status="placeholder" />

blocks.raw: <Callout>Reading the arc this way reveals a key insight: each layer presupposes the one before it. You cannot meaningfully discuss a philosophical position without grounding in the elements and principles that position was arguing about. You cannot apply space planning theory without understanding design perception. The sequence is a learning sequence, not just an organizational one.</Callout>
